name: Unit Load

wrapped.label: Stretch wrapped
wrapped.desc: The load is stretch-wrapped: at Run it is one rigid body with film round it, and it carries the mark wrapped for anything downstream that checks. Off, its pieces start loose.

loadId.label: Load ID
loadId.desc: The label on the load (an SSCC, a licence plate). Carried as the mark loadId, so a scanner or a program can tell loads apart.

courses.label: Courses
courses.desc: With no cargo filed under the load, it stacks this many courses of cases on a pallet itself (0.4 m each; three is a full load). 0 = the load is the pallet and cases filed under it.

caseColor.label: Case color
caseColor.desc: Tint of the cases it stacks itself. White leaves the cardboard untinted.

filmColor.label: Film color
filmColor.desc: Colour of the stretch film: clear film has a faint blue, and loads are also wrapped in white or black film to hide what is inside.

filmOpacity.label: Film opacity
filmOpacity.desc: How see-through the film is. Clear film shows the cases through it; white or black film is nearly opaque.
